# Draftava 1.3.22
This update improves the transition to Draftava's new project format.
- Automatically detects and migrates existing V1 projects when needed. - Preserves the original project and verifies the migrated content. - Opens the familiar Draftava editor after successful migration. - Remembers the converted project for future launches. - Corrects the macOS folder-access flow.
macOS may request one-time permission to access the project destination.
